evidence.quote: Tonight, I want to briefly discuss the role that participation plays in the Federal Reserve's work and outline one effort to solicit broad participation--an upcoming conference on stress tests, intended to make those tests more open, transparent, and effective.
over the course of 2019, we will be reviewing our monetary policy strategy, tools, and communication practices
In July, as a forum for such ideas, we will host a public conference focused on the transparency and effectiveness of stress testing.

parsed.rationale: The speech is about accountability, transparency, and stress-testing supervision, with only a procedural mention of the monetary policy framework review. It offers no view on rates, inflation, activity, or the balance sheet, so the stance is neutral.
